messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD-RULE: reserved-capacity-throttle — tenant=zeta — 90th_latency > 800ms for 5m :rotating_light:
pagerduty: page fired to carmen@oncall — incident #PD123456 acknowledged?
carmen: acked. I'm on it. pulling up metrics now.
mina: saw the spike in the metrics dashboard. 1/2 of zeta's reserved pool saturated, queue started spiking. errors are 502 from runtime_proxy.
jake: runtime logs show spike in kv-cache misses and many cold starts for long sequences. looks like cached prefixes not hitting for a subset of model variants.
olivia: customer (Zeta Health) on Slack complaining about 4xx/5xxs in their UI. cc @cs-eng. They're seeing timeouts for their PDF-summarize endpoint.
carmen: ok plan: 1) scale their reserved pool by +2 gpus (temp), 2) enable fallback routing to compatible warm pool, 3) add short-term rate-limit for heavy batch jobs. who's available to execute?
jake: I can reroute traffic and push a policy. Running the routing command now.

```bash
# add fallback policy for tenant zeta
redwoodctl routes add --tenant zeta --fallback-model rdx-small-qa --priority 10
kubectl scale deployment zeta-dedicated-pool --replicas=6 -n rdx-dedicated
```

mina: scaling triggered, new nodes booting. we should watch autoscaler events — might take ~90s for gpus to be ready.
carmen: triggering manual burst capacity in the control plane for zeta to bypass cold start for new replicas.
incident-bot: Manual intervention recorded by carmen.
pagerduty: escalation: still unacknowledged by second-level after 3m. notifying next-oncall.
next-oncall: saw the escalation, joining. what's the customer impact window?
olivia: CS confirmed customer-visible errors started ~08:03 UTC; affected both sync and async endpoints; roughly 30% of requests returning 5xx and 60% increased tail latency.
jake: after enabling fallback routing, error rate dropped from 30% -> ~7% in 2m. latency improving but 95th still high ~700ms. KV cache warmup ongoing.
mina: added a temporary eviction policy tweak to prioritize tenant zeta kvcache entries (ttl bump). sending the change now.
carmen: can we temporarily block large batch jobs from this tenant? they have a nightly bulk job that might be hammering the pool.
olivia: confirmed they pushed a large backfill at 07:58 UTC — they thought it was low priority. asked them to pause.
jake: added a per-tenant-weight rule to scheduler and moved any running large batches to lower priority queue.

```text
2026-03-14T08:07:12Z metrics: tenant=zeta reserved_usage=95% queue_len=120 errors_5xx=28%
2026-03-14T08:09:05Z metrics: reserved_usage=64% queue_len=32 errors_5xx=7% kv_cache_hit=72%
```

mina: looks stable enough to remove manual burst after warmup — but keep fallback policy in place for 30m.
carmen: agree. I'll start the handoff to next-oncall in 10 minutes. please capture all actions in the incident doc.
next-oncall: taking handoff. what's outstanding?
mina: followups: 1) run replay on blocked requests to validate no regression 2) audit autoscaler logs for why reserved pool didn't scale earlier 3) create a mitigations runbook for tenant large-batch protection.
jake: i'll open a PR to the scheduler to add a soft limit per-tenant for batch capacity.
olivia: CS sent a short status update to Zeta: we mitigated immediate errors, full postmortem to follow.
incident-bot: Incident PD123456 closed by carmen. Duration: 17m. Primary symptoms: reserved pool saturation -> KV-cache misses -> increased cold starts. Root cause suspected: concurrent backfill batch + model variant mismatch causing higher mem usage.
carmen: Nice work team. please add all logs/commands to the incident doc and tag the runtime and autoscaler teams for the postmortem.
next-oncall: I have it. I'll own the action items and coordinate with runtime for a permanent fix. handoff complete :white_check_mark:
mina: adding notes to #postmortems and will schedule a blameless RCA.
jake: also recommend adding a dashboard warning for sustained per-tenant queue length > 60 for >3m.
olivia: I'll follow up with Zeta CS to provide timeline and mitigation steps.
incident-bot: Reminder: create incident ticket in JIRA with label "tenant-reserved-saturation".
carmen: filing now. ticket RD-INC-2026-045 created.
mina: closing loop here. great response, minimal customer downtime after reroute.
